name: @ringsnetwork/rings-node
description: Rings is a structured peer-to-peer network implementation using WebRTC, Chord algorithm, and full WebAssembly (WASM) support.

scripts.wasm_pack: wasm-pack build crates/node --release --scope ringsnetwork -t web --no-default-features --features browser_default --features console_error_panic_hook
scripts.prepare: npm run wasm_pack && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp crates/node/pkg/rings_node* ./dist && cp index.ts ./dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build:frontend-extension-scripts: tsc -p examples/frontend/tsconfig.extension-assets.json && tsc -p examples/frontend/tsconfig.scripts.json && node examples/frontend/scripts/check-extension-docs.mjs && ! grep -R -nE '\bany\b' examples/frontend/extension-assets/*.ts examples/frontend/scripts/*.mts
